verdict.rationale: The README lists Docker as an official installation and run path ('Run with Docker - see our Docker documentation') with a dedicated Docker section, so first-party support for running llama.cpp in a container is documented. The pack itself contains only brief pointers to that documentation, not its contents. Missing for 10: details on published images and tags (CPU/CUDA/server variants), GPU passthrough and version-pinning guidance, and independent or hands-on reports of containerized deployment.
